title: MapsRenderRequestV1
description: Asks the map renderer for a detailed render of the map in `file`. Defaults: `maxSide` 4096, `maxBytes` 8 MiB, and the map as the game shows it: `darkness` and `buildings` true, `ores`, `grid` and `spawns` false.

darkness.description: The game's darkness over static walls and outside the map. Default true.

buildings.description: Buildings and their shadows; false draws the terrain only. Default true.

ores.description: Ores stand out: tiles without one are dimmed and greyed. Default false.

grid.description: A line every 10 tiles and a brighter one every 50, labelled with its tile coordinates (y up, as in game). Default false.

spawns.description: Enemy spawns with their drop zones (the rules' dropZoneRadius). Default false.
